DiabloMasteryFeastOnFearBlackSoulstone.name: Feast on Fear
DiabloMasteryFeastOnFearBlackSoulstone.description: Stunning an enemy Hero with Shadow Charge or Overpower heals Diablo for 10% of his maximum Health over 3 seconds.

DiabloMasteryDevilsDueBlackSoulstone.name: Devil's Due
DiabloMasteryDevilsDueBlackSoulstone.description: Black Soulstone increases the effects of Regen Globes and Healing Fountains by 2.25% per Soul.

DiabloSoulShield.name: Soul Shield
DiabloSoulShield.description: Activate to gain 25 plus 50% of Diablo's current Souls as Spell Armor for 4 seconds. Every time Diablo damages an enemy Hero, reduce this cooldown by 1 second.

DiabloShadowChargeSacrificialSoul.name: Sacrificial Soul
DiabloShadowChargeSacrificialSoul.description: Stunning a Hero with Shadow Charge grants 10 Souls and 20 Armor for 3 seconds. While at 100 Souls, increase this Armor to 40.

DiabloFireStompSoulsToTheFlame.name: Souls to the Flame
DiabloFireStompSoulsToTheFlame.description: Fire Stomp grants 1 Soul every 3 times it damages an enemy Hero, and heals for an additional 1.3% of its damage dealt per Soul.

DiabloLifeLeech.name: Life Leech
DiabloLifeLeech.description: Diablo gains 1 Soul and heals for 1.75% of his maximum Health when Basic Attacking an enemy Hero. While at 100 Souls, increase this healing to 3.5% of his maximum Health.

DiabloShadowChargeOverpowerEternalFlames.name: Eternal Flames
DiabloShadowChargeOverpowerEternalFlames.description: Reduce the cooldown of Fire Stomp by 1 second. When Diablo Stuns an enemy Hero with Shadow Charge or Overpower, reset the cooldown of Fire Stomp and restore 45 Mana.

DiabloMalevolence.name: Malevolence
DiabloMalevolence.description: Basic Abilities cause Diablo's next Basic Attack within 6 seconds to deal an additional 100 Spell Damage. Stores up to 2 charges.

DiabloDiabolicalMomentum.name: Diabolical Momentum
DiabloDiabolicalMomentum.description: When Diablo's Basic Attacks damage enemies, reduce the cooldown of Shadow Charge and Overpower by 2 seconds.

DiabloHeroicAbilityApocalypse.name: Apocalypse
DiabloHeroicAbilityApocalypse.description: Create a demonic rune under each enemy Hero on the battleground. After 1.75 seconds the rune explodes dealing 137 damage and Stunning them for 1.75 seconds.

DiabloHeroicAbilityLightningBreath.name: Lightning Breath
DiabloHeroicAbilityLightningBreath.description: After 0.5 seconds, become Unstoppable and Channel for up to 4 seconds, dealing 50 damage every 0.25 seconds to enemies in front of Diablo. Enemies affected are Slowed by 4% for 2 seconds, up to 40%. Lightning Breath's direction changes with your mouse cursor position.

DiabloDevastatingCharge.name: Devastating Charge
DiabloDevastatingCharge.description: Increase Shadow Charge's terrain collision damage by 50%. Quest: Hit an enemy Hero against terrain 5 times. Reward: Hitting enemy Heroes against terrain reduces their Armor by 20 for 4 seconds.

DiabloHellfire.name: Hellfire
DiabloHellfire.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Fire Stomp grants 3% Spell Power for 10 seconds, up to 30%. While at maximum stacks, Diablo deals 33 damage per second to nearby enemies.

DiabloShadowChargeOverpowerCruelty.name: Cruelty
DiabloShadowChargeOverpowerCruelty.description: Stunning an enemy Hero with Shadow Charge or Overpower increases Diablo's Attack Speed by 50% for 7 seconds, up to 100%.

DiabloTalentDominationOverpower.name: Domination
DiabloTalentDominationOverpower.description: Casting Overpower resets the cooldown of Shadow Charge.

DiabloDebilitatingFlames.name: Debilitating Flames
DiabloDebilitatingFlames.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Fire Stomp are Slowed by 6% for 4 seconds, up to 60%. Heroes Slowed by 24% or more by Debilitating Flames deal 50% less damage.

DiabloOverpowerOverpoweringNightmare.name: Overpowering Nightmare
DiabloOverpowerOverpoweringNightmare.description: Gain 2 additional charges of Overpower, with a 2 second cooldown between uses.

DiabloMasteryDyingBreathApocalypse.name: Dying Breath
DiabloMasteryDyingBreathApocalypse.description: Apocalypse's cooldown is reduced by 30 seconds for every enemy Hero hit (to a minimum of 5 seconds) and is cast for free when Diablo dies.

DiabloTalentLordOfTerror.name: Lord of Terror
DiabloTalentLordOfTerror.description: Activate to steal 12% of the maximum Health of nearby enemy Heroes and gain 5 Souls per Hero hit.

DiabloHellgate.name: Hellgate
DiabloHellgate.description: Teleport and place a demonic rune at target location. After 1.75 seconds the rune explodes dealing 137 damage and stunning enemies for 1.75 seconds.
